description.value: Grist and Mash Brewery is a craft microbrewery tucked into Kimberley, BC, offering an ever-rotating selection of draft beers on-site and for off-sales in crowler cans or growler bottles. A stocked beer fridge provides ready-to-go specialty craft options, and house-prepared seasonal boards round out the experience. For cyclists passing through the Kimberley area, it offers a relaxed stop for a locally brewed pint in a no-smoking environment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active craft brewery at 345 Wallinger Avenue, Kimberley, matching the OSM address; it also provides a phone number (250-427-0148) absent from OSM. The website explicitly references takeout beer sales ('beer fridge with specialty craft beer to go', crowler/growler off-sales) and seasonal food boards, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities. The OSM name uses 'and' while the website consistently uses '&', noted as a minor discrepancy.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Grist and Mash Brewery' while the website consistently uses 'Grist & Mash Brewery' (ampersand). Minor typographic difference.
Phone number (250-427-0148) appears only on the website; OSM record has no phone field populated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active craft brewery in Kimberley with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking local beer and light food.

wow_evidence: craft microbrewery tucked into Kimberley, BC, with crowler/growler off-sales
